name: Grinnell Glacier
why: Above Swiftcurrent and Josephine lakes and under waterfalls to the moraine of Grinnell Glacier, where icebergs float on a milky blue lake.
book: Vehicle reservation for Many Glacier in summer (recreation.gov). The Glacier Park Boat Company boats across Swiftcurrent Lake and Lake Josephine cut 6 km. The upper trail opens only when snow and bears allow, often mid-July.
water: Streams and a toilet at the picnic area below the glacier; filter.
dangers: Grizzly bears are common: carry bear spray and make noise.
Snow on the upper switchbacks; the trail closes for bear activity.
Do not walk on the glacier or the ice in the lake.
